explanation: Executable, observation-grounded pick-and-place for the current request. It measures the cream-cheese lid, supporting tabletop, persistent printed landmarks and bowl inner lip; checks rectangular extent, supported height, opening fit and the actual robot finger envelope; and aligns only the gripper opening axis as needed. The inferred lower box face is explicitly based on visible flat-box support, not a measured hidden underside. It approaches in bounded pose-feedback leases, checks actual finger entry, closes, and uses a short upward action to measure retention rather than assume it. Independent observed box motion must agree with actual TCP motion. It transports above the measured lip, checks current footprint and release height, releases, retreats, and verifies the actual bowl relation and settling across two observations. Tracker failure invokes fresh semantically corresponding RGB-D landmarks and an uncertainty-checked rigid fit; patch initialization has one alternative ROI. A justified upward observation action can resolve a local view gap. Historical checkpoints preserve reference provenance and phase evidence across repairs without treating them as current sensors. Explicit obstruction, ambiguous identity, unsuccessful leases, stalls, inadequate measurements or exhausted reserves produce an incomplete result without blind pushing or reopening. Local checks are not collision certificates, tracker uncertainty is heuristic, and completion is only proposed.
interface: Define main(api), with np, math and geo supplied by the documented runtime; no imports or external resources. The user goal is cream cheese into bowl, with all coordinates and geometry acquired during this episode, not a stored trajectory. Return a JSON-compatible dictionary containing boolean completion_proposed and evidence, optionally limitations. Use only state, review, point, plane_point, compose, track_init, track_update, control, drive, note, checkpoint and recall. Every review declares exact structured fields and explicit enum unknown outcomes where applicable. Initial review selects two named surface regions, three persistent printed-landmark points, four lid-corner pixels and six inner-lip pixels; direct lip sampling uses radius 1. Region/point dictionary membership and measurement_errors are checked, invalid individual lip measurements are logged, and fits require sufficient valid samples. All helper array results are converted at API/JSON boundaries. Audited helper keys include plane coefficients/center/spread diagnostics, circle center_xy_m/radius_m/rms_m/max_radial_error_m/largest_angular_gap_rad, and tracker frame_id/reference_frame_id, never a fabricated current-frame alias. Ordinary motion uses drive; contact/settling pulses use control. Each lease has at most 12 real Jev calls; each route has at most 16 legs, with 0.16 m open-workspace and 0.06 m near-contact waypoints, plus at most one justified 0.018 m view change. Individual commands are limited to 0.02 m and 0.08 rad, three native steps, with 0.003 m and 0.05 rad pose tolerances. A lease that does not reach stops instead of silently reducing minimum progress. GPT/Jev/native-step reserves protect release and verification. The cream_method checkpoint contains bounded historical measurements, semantic definitions, uncertainties, actual states and phase evidence; handles are not reused after a repair.
jev_protocol: Every physical action goes through control, directly or inside drive, and therefore calls real Jev. Exactly seven choice questions are supplied: x,y,z,rx,ry,rz with negative/hold/positive, and gripper with open/close/keep. Each axis instruction explicitly names its subject and state.processed_features.axes.<axis>.goal_relation: decrease maps to negative, within_tolerance to hold, increase to positive. Positive translation increases the world coordinate; positive rotation increases that world rotation-vector component. The gripper instruction explicitly reads state.processed_features.objective.gripper and selects the matching operation. The host dispatches these choices unchanged using residual-derived magnitudes, L2 bounds and documented deadbands; the program does not substitute Jev directions. Pose targets refer to pad_center, with quaternion composition and measured own geometry accounting for TCP offset and the tool-y opening axis. Program features sent to Jev include phase, the measured local obstruction/visibility/basis interpretation, waypoint and a non-certification flag; trusted host features add current robot state and pose errors. Review, not Jev, supplies fresh image interpretations and measurement selections. Review outcomes distinguish an observed external obstacle, no visible obstacle, and undetermined evidence; visible local space, self-occlusion, and unobserved external space are distinct. A finite local branch permits progress only with a stated attainable local basis, otherwise one independently justified upward view action or an exact-gap stop. Contact choice delivery and reached poses are not grasp evidence. Retention uses geo.attachment_error plus measured hand/object lift; transfer revalidates attachment after every leg. Opening is allowed only after numerical current-footprint checks and fresh release-relation review. Final completion requires post-release interior placement, resting support, exact landmark correspondence and no more than 0.006 m landmark displacement over an acknowledged settling interval. No Jev choice is treated as an image sensor, hidden predicate or metric calculator.
